svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Serverless web API on AWS
svg.desc: Serverless web API on AWS. 8 components in 2 groups. Connections: Users to Amazon CloudFront (HTTPS); Users to Amazon Cognito (sign in); Amazon CloudFront to Web app bucket (static files); Amazon CloudFront to Amazon API Gateway (/api/*); Amazon Cognito to Amazon API Gateway (Cognito authorizer); Amazon API Gateway to Orders function; Orders function to Orders table; Orders function to Receipts bucket.

text.tspan: Single-page app on CloudFront, REST API on API Gateway and Lambda, Cognito sign-in
